question: What is the annual retention rate of legislators who began their first term between January 1, 1917 and December 31, 1999, measured as the proportion of this cohort still in office on December 31st for each of the first 20 years following their initial term start? The results should show all 20 periods in sequence regardless of whether any legislators were retained in a particular year.

-- Final query: annual retention rate of legislators cohort
WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE term_number = 0
      AND term_start >= '1917-01-01'
      AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
cohort_size AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM cohort
),
years AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(1, 20)) as year_num
),
cohort_years AS (
    SELECT c.id_bioguide, c.first_term_start, y.year_num,
           date_trunc('year', (c.first_term_start::DATE + CAST(y.year_num AS INTEGER) * INTERVAL '1 year')) + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as target_date
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN years y
),
retention_detail AS (
    SELECT cy.year_num, cy.id_bioguide,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
               WHERE lt.id_bioguide = cy.id_bioguide
                 AND lt.term_start::DATE <= cy.target_date
                 AND lt.term_end::DATE >= cy.target_date
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
    FROM cohort_years cy
),
retention AS (
    SELECT year_num, 
           SUM(retained) as retained_count
    FROM retention_detail
    GROUP BY year_num
)
SELECT r.year_num, 1.0 * r.retained_count / cs.total as retention_rate
FROM retention r, cohort_size cs
ORDER BY r.year_num
